verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official CLI usable from terminal, coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines, with concrete features like source-map injection/upload for error tracking, and this is corroborated by a dedicated docs page and a probe confirming the CLI documentation is live. missing for 10: independent hands-on community review of the CLI itself (community evidence only covers MCP/LLM features, not the CLI specifically).
